# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

All versions of the project are currently supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| All     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities by creating a new issue, or by contacting the maintainer directly if the issue is sensitive.

We take all security vulnerabilities seriously and will try our best to address them as quickly as possible. Thank you for improving the security of this open source project.
